audit.whatIsWrong: Aurora's kit was described wrongly in four places. Her ultimate was said to 'remove buffs', 'grant a temporary shield/speed burst that resets on takedown', 'cleanse your Charm' and enable 'ult-reset chaining'. Between Worlds does none of that: she leaps, shockwaves for damage and a slow, then leaves a slowing area she can teleport across. Her passive was called 'a stacking mark' when Spirit Abjuration exorcises spirits that follow her and heal her. No ability was ever named.
audit.why: A reader told Aurora cleanses Charm will hold E for a cleanse that does not exist, and a reader told her ult resets on takedown will disengage from a fight she is winning.

notes: Four fabricated claims about Between Worlds shipped here: that it removes buffs, grants a shield and speed burst, resets on takedown, and cleanses CC. Riot's text gives it a leap, a damaging slow shockwave, and a slow field she can teleport across — nothing else. The 'she can cleanse your Charm' line was the most dangerous, because it tells an Ahri to hold her single most important cooldown for a threat that does not exist. Her passive was also miscast as a stacking mark when it is a heal, which is why anti-heal now appears in the itemization line. packet flagged sequencingCues=0 for this matchup; the cooldown block and both do's now carry real numbers.
